Reading a population pyramid

Placeholder paragraph for the test fixture. A population pyramid shows each age cohort as two bars, males on the left and females on the right. A wide base means many young people; a narrow base and a wide top mean an older population. The sex ratio compares males and females at each age. Read the pyramid for Country A, a placeholder place, at the national scale.
